title: Soumya murder case
narrative: FIR — Soumya murder case, Kerala. On 1 February 2011, Soumya, a 23-year-old saleswoman, was travelling alone in the women's coach of a passenger train from Ernakulam to Shoranur when she was attacked by Govindachamy, a repeat offender from Tamil Nadu. He pushed her from the moving train near Vallathol Nagar, jumped off, and raped her. She succumbed to her injuries at a hospital on 6 February 2011. Govindachamy was arrested on 3 February 2011, convicted, and initially sentenced to death; the Supreme Court later commuted the murder conviction, retaining the sentence for rape.
